_comment: EXAMPLE camera calibration -- an overhead head camera 0.6 m above the
arm frame's origin, looking straight down. Identical to camera.lex's
`overhead_camera` helper, whose documented projections the tests assert.
REPLACE with your own: 'pos' is the camera position in the ARM frame,
and right/down/forward are its axes as world-frame vectors. fx/fy are
normalized focal lengths, cx0/cy0 the principal point in 0..1 image
coordinates. Wrong numbers here yield confidently wrong world positions.
